svg.title: Pocket Lab Lite · Security Architecture
svg.desc: Static architecture security overlay showing trust zones, canonical flows, controls, assets, forbidden paths and modeled attack paths. Modeled flow — not live traffic. Motion is explanatory and never represents a live connection or active attack.
svg.text: Static model · canonical architecture · promoted evidence · human review
